_status: PROPOSED 2026-10-17 (RUNBOOK 4.3). Severities and response channels are proposals for the M2 FMECA-lite; the M2 gate requires a source for every entry. Do not use as final cost-matrix values.

_severity_scale.standard: ECSS-Q-ST-30-02C severity categories, dependability consequences (verify wording against the standard in M2)
_severity_scale.1: Catastrophic: failure propagation to other units / hazard
_severity_scale.4: Minor: minor mission degradation or any other effect

_response_channels.report: no onboard action beyond flagging; ground trend analysis

_label_source: fault ids and names: fault_dict in the dataset's own generation code (Data_generate_code_20260309.zip, XJTU-SPS for FD.py / for AD.py); dataset arXiv:2601.12667

1.name: SA_partial component or branch open circuit
1.rationale: array power reduced by the lost branch; battery covers the deficit while margin lasts

2.name: SA_partial component or branch short circuit
2.rationale: shorted branch is lost and loads the array; isolate the branch

3.name: SA_component deterioration
3.rationale: slow loss of power margin; trended on ground, load plan adapted

4.name: BCR_open circuit
4.rationale: battery cannot recharge; without redundancy it depletes over orbits; shed loads to stretch energy

5.name: BCR_short circuit
5.rationale: uncontrolled charging can overcharge the battery and propagate (cell overvoltage / thermal); limit charge and isolate the array

6.name: BCR_increased power loss
6.rationale: less charge per orbit and more heat; trend and adapt

7.name: BAT_degradation
7.rationale: less eclipse energy; deeper DoD accelerates fade; shed secondary loads in eclipse

8.name: BAT_open circuit
8.rationale: no eclipse energy from the string; with no spare string, eclipse loads are lost

10.name: Bus_short circuit
10.rationale: overcurrent on the common bus propagates to every unit; isolate and shed

11.name: Bus_insulation breakdown
11.rationale: leakage current and possible escalation to a short

12.name: PDM1_open circuit or short circuit
12.rationale: one distribution channel lost; a short is contained by channel protection

15.name: Load1_open circuit
15.rationale: one load stops drawing power; no EPS hazard

work_modes.4: Joint power supply, sunlit, ground-orientation task 2

fdir_artefact_modes._source: plan doc, 'RAMS and FDIR' (the FDIR artefact is an FMECA item, ECSS-Q-ST-30-02C HSIA); not dataset labels

A1.name: tree table bit flip (SEU)
A1.mitigation: SGO v2 output sanitisation, CBMC P1/P2 (ISS-015)

A2.name: non-finite or implausible telemetry
A2.mitigation: SGO v2 plausibility gate, CBMC P7-P9 (ISS-014)

A3.name: wrong SoC estimate / overconfident sigma
A3.mitigation: EKF guards + CBMC E2-E7; coverage calibration (ISS-018, ISS-025 open)

A4.name: UART desync between DAQ and DUT
